headline: Gautam Saraogi files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Gautam Saraogi has submitted a substantial acquisition disclosure to NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4). The filing indicates a required regulatory update by a promoter or acquirer in respect of Go Fashion (India) Limited shares.
detail: Gautam Saraogi has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, with the National Stock Exchange. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a person or entity crosses a prescribed shareholding threshold or acquires control. The filing does not specify the shareholding percentage, acquisition value, or transaction structure in the headline disclosure; the full details are contained in the formal Form - filed with the exchange. This is a mandatory regulatory filing, likely triggered by an acquisition event or threshold breach.
